758:t_1:1186.en:
$$ミサコ#pilot$$
「Are you all right yourself, $$マキ#pilot$$? I heard the war left you with memory problems...」

758:t_1:1187.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Thank you, $$ミサコ#pilot$$. But I can't afford to complain.」

758:t_1:1188.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「With things the way they are, I'll do what I can as a nurse too.」

758:t_1:1189.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
(But what is this... pain lingering deep in my heart...?)

758:t_1:1190.en:
$n
($$シンヤ#pilot$$, $$ミサコ#pilot$$... I don't need to worry anymore...)

758:t_1:1191.en:
$n
(Goodbye, $$マキ#pilot$$... I'm counting on you... to take care of those two.)

759:t_000:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then, $n... I'll hand over all control of the $$ソーラリアン$$ to you.」

759:t_000:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「But are you really sure? Without the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, there's a limit to what it can do.」

759:t_000:3.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ and the $$スフィア$$ were both lost in that battle, after all.」

759:t_000:4.en:
$n
「I'll be using this $$ソーラリアン$$ for my journey from now on.」

759:t_000:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「An adventurer roaming parallel worlds... A $$ゲートトラベラー$$ traveling on his own... That's one big dream you've got.」

759:t_000:6.en:
$$エスター$$
「But are you really all right going alone...?」

759:t_000:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then here's a present to mark your departure. Look at the hangar monitor.」

759:t_001:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I repaired it as much as I could. Use it on your journey.」

759:t_001:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like your guides have arrived too.」

759:t_002:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Though $c disbanded when the space-time repair was completed.」

759:t_002:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But this gate, installed near Earth, lets us travel between parallel worlds.」

759:t_002:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「The worlds are back the way they were, but we can still meet again like this.」

759:t_002:4.en:
$n
「So that's our new world... the hyperdimensional world...」

759:t_002:5.en:
$$葵$$
「That's why we've come to see you off and give the gate a test run at the same time.」

759:t_002:7.en:
$$シン$$
「$n... Did you... cut your hair?」

759:t_002:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It doesn't look any different...」

759:t_002:10.en:
$n
「I trimmed three centimeters off the damaged ends.」

759:t_002:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$n! If you're traveling through parallel worlds, we'll be your guides for now!」

759:t_002:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The gate has only just started operating. We don't know what might happen.」

759:t_002:15.en:
$$キラ$$
「Can you operate the $$ソーラリアン$$ alone without $$ＡＧ$$?」

759:t_002:16.en:
$n
「Dr. $$トライア$$ modified it for me.」

759:t_002:17.en:
???
「...But you'll need a navigator, won't you?」

759:t_002:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't 'Miss $$スズネ$$' me. You decided to travel parallel worlds without consulting me or even telling me.」

759:t_002:20.en:
$n
「Oh... Um... I thought I'd visit all the worlds everyone in $c comes from...」

759:t_002:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know exactly what you're up to, $n.」

759:t_002:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So all of Class 3-4 at $$陣代高校$$ agreed to help Miss $$スズネ$$.」

759:t_002:23.en:
$n
「But, Miss $$スズネ$$... Your dream is to graduate from college and become a teacher...」

759:t_002:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't leave such a hopeless student on his own.」

759:t_002:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll go with you. Broadening my horizons is necessary to become a teacher.」

759:t_002:27.en:
$$ニア$$
「Then you're going on a honeymoon too, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

759:t_002:28.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you. I wish you and $$シモン$$ happiness too, $$ニア$$.」

759:t_002:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make a woman say any more embarrassing things. Let's go.」

759:t_002:32.en:
$$クロウ$$
「See you, $n! Give my regards to $$ランド$$, $$セツコ$$, and everyone else!」

759:t_002:33.en:
$$エスター$$
「Make sure you come home! With Miss $$スズネ$$!」

759:t_003:1.en:
$n
(Dad, Mom, Sis... Everyone in $c, $$ＡＧ$$... I'll be going.)

759:t_003:2.en:
$n
(I'll go to see with my own eyes the many worlds we protected... this hyperdimensional world.)
